incidents_during_s2.mechanism: pytest imports every test module during collection, before any test executes; SCIENCE's module-level 'from urban_network_analysis.Engines import Accessibility' made collection import Engines/Accessibility.py, whose line 6 writes os.environ['USE_PYGEOS']='0' in the pytest process; the D3 test then spawned its check subprocess inheriting that environment, so the facade was (falsely) seen to have written the variable
incidents_during_s2.resolution: SCIENCE-owned fix only: legacy engines imported at RUN time via a module-scoped fixture in test_bug_triples.py / test_tea_audit.py (directory order runs platform_geometry before science, so the D3 test executes before any engine import); whole-repo regression rerun green
incidents_during_s2.recorded_for_integrate: the D3 test remains fragile against ANY earlier in-process engine import (e.g. 'pytest tests/science tests/platform_geometry' order): its subprocess inherits the parent environment, so it cannot distinguish the facade's own writes from inherited parent state. A one-line repair (spawn with an explicit env scrubbing USE_PYGEOS) belongs to TOPOLOGY's owned file and needs a TOPOLOGY delta-ledger entry, so it is recorded here as a handoff rather than edited cross-scope
